call_points.text: Boric Acid capacity expansion under board discussion; debottlenecking to add 1,000-1,500 tonnes.
DOT volumes to rise from 980 tonnes to ~1,500 tonnes in FY27, still only a quarter of 6,000-tonne capacity.
Boric Acid realisation rose to ₹127-128/kg in FY26 from ₹114-115/kg a year earlier.
EBITDA per kg for Boric Acid is about ₹28-29, or 20-21% margin.
Company remains zero-debt; cash being moved from FDs to mutual funds for liquidity ahead of capex.
Promoter share pledge loan-to-value question was not answered, referred to investor relations.
Management remains optimistic about opportunities from Aatmanirbhar Bharat and Make in India initiatives.

operating_notes.text: Postal ballot closed 08-05-2026 with 17,094,723 of 32,090,000 shares (53.27%) voted; promoters hold 16,300,230 shares.
Board recommended a final dividend of ₹10 per share and a special dividend of ₹30 per share for FY26.
Boric acid manufacturing capacity is 20,000 MTPA and DOT capacity is 6,000 MTPA at Pithampur, MP.
Boric Acid Technical volumes were ~15,000 tonnes in FY26; I.P. grade ~900 tonnes; DOT 980 tonnes; Boron Oxide and traded products ~400 tonnes.
Boric Acid realisation was ₹127-128/kg in FY26 versus ₹114-115/kg in FY25; EBITDA per kg is ₹28-29.
DOT realisation is about ₹150/kg; India DOT market is ~8,500 tonnes, with the company at 7-8% share.
Indo Borax holds 2,38,44,000 Kronox Lab Sciences shares (64.26%); 51,94,560 of them (~14% of Kronox) are pledged to the lender of its ~₹225 Cr acquisition term loan.
Indo Borax became promoter of Kronox Lab Sciences on 29 September 2026, with Zenrock Chemicals Private Limited a member of the promoter group.

timeline.summary: On 11 May 2026 Indo Borax reported that all four postal ballot resolutions — ESOP 2026, the 1% option grant, Section 186 limits and director commission — passed, with 51.19% of public institution votes against the ESOP.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹63.01 Cr (+25.7% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹15.82 Cr.
On May 28, 2026, Indo Borax & Chemicals released its Q4 and FY26 investor presentation reporting revenue of ₹215.45 Cr and a total dividend of ₹40 per share.
Pravin Prabhakar Chavan, CFO, shared the audio link for the FY26 earnings call discussing audited standalone and consolidated results for Q4 and FY ended March 31, 2026, via the company website.
Sunil Malhotra (Director, Zenrock Chemicals Pvt Ltd) declared no new encumbrances on Indo Borax & Chemicals Ltd’s equity shares as of April 7, 2026.
On June 2, 2026, Indo Borax's Q4/FY26 earnings call guided FY27 revenue to ₹250 Cr+ and said the Boron Oxide project's first lot is three to four quarters away.

On October 19, 2026, Indo Borax pledged 51,94,560 Kronox Lab Sciences shares (~14% of Kronox) to a lender as security for a ~₹225 Cr term loan taken to fund the Kronox acquisition; it still holds 64.26% of Kronox.

On 22 October 2026, Indo Borax amended its 20 August 2026 share purchase agreement for Kronox Lab Sciences, deleting the sellers' lock-in (Clause 9.5) and its right of first refusal (Clause 9.6) over the sellers' 9.95% stake.
